estilo: Vertical editorial interior photograph for an architecture magazine, photorealistic, natural daylight, straight vertical lines, correct perspective, realistic materials and proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no distortion.

imagens.uso: "porcelanato que imita a grama" — referências da cliente (piso cerâmico rústico gramado / garden)
imagens.prompt: Apartment balcony floor covered with square ceramic floor tiles printed with exactly the pattern of @estampa: pale irregular stones separated by printed green grass, an obviously artificial printed look with a slight glossy sheen, visible straight tile joints forming a square grid, laid the same way as the floor in @assentado. Glass railing, one simple outdoor armchair, soft city daylight.
